name: E5 planes and stack-up
description: Phase 1 slice E5 (ADR-0047) in the real window. SETUP through execute_command: a 40 x 30 mm 4-layer board, a GND via, a bottom GND pour over the whole board and a top GND pour that misses the via. Then, by real X input: the PCB editor gets the engine's fill of both zones (the DRC raster); the Layers panel lists the top pour as dead copper removed; Design > Stitch zones runs StitchZones and the top pour is filled; copper weight and finished thickness are edited in the stack-up table, each a SetStackup the engine validates and returns; a plane layer gets the GND net (AddZone over the outline); after a webview reload the edited stack-up comes back from the project.
